notes: No front-runner's tyre stop is reported (Prost, Lauda, Senna appear to have run non-stop, but no source states it). Motor Sport Nov 1984 (https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/november-1984/76/another-mclaren-double/) reports Johansson (#20) stopping for a new nose after contact and Warwick (#16) stopping for new Michelins after a spin, both without laps.
